fee_notes: Standard fee is $17,500 ($10,000 deposit at application, $7,500 at signing). Associate discount (5+ year employees) reduces fee to $10,000. Renewal franchisees pay no initial fee but pay a successor administration fee. Fee is non-refundable if franchise broker was involved.
